items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: we went down and played the Three Deuces in Chicago where Tatum was playing

ctx.x: Well you can't even get them to audition. Right, right, right. Which reminds me, did you ever make many auditions?

Oh man, that was a common thing, auditions. I tell the band, listen man, we've got an audition tomorrow. Just like the Three Deuces, we went down and played the Three Deuces in Chicago where Tatum was playing and we must have played a half day for the boss man. We auditioned here in New Orleans to play on the boat. And Captain Vern Stryfus came to hear us up at the Pelican. He used to bring the metronome with him to see if your tempos varied. He was tough. Sure they did this on the boat. If any of these guys can…
What boat was this, which one? President. Did you work on the President?
